name: template-variants
body: Template variants are expressed as enum field(s) whose value changes the layout (e.g. `layout: image-left | image-right`); this is the only variant mechanism. An enum field's variants are declared inline with `variants:` or expanded from a library-relative glob with `variants_from:`; the two are alternatives, and declaring both, or a glob matching nothing, is a templates error (enum-variants-from).
